Authorize. approve and expire-early tokens answer 201 with the hold id and its expiry; a decline token answers 402 payment-declined with the decline code (final); a timeout token answers 504 provider-timeout after a short delay (transient, retry with the same key; the timeout scenario is answered before the Idempotency-Key is claimed, so it is never stored or replayed, and its body is not validated). A card number or an unrecognised token is a 422 validation-failed. A decline token only checks that amountMinor is positive.
